text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Would you care to visit a hot spring 
village with me sometime?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While sorting through the acquired texts 
with Azuma-san, 
I received an unexpected invitation.
choice_data_list: I'd love to, but... why so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You invited me to a sacred ritual before, 
did you not? 
I thought that this time, it should be my 
turn.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The children of man are fond of hot 
springs 
for rest and leisure, are they not? 
If it pleases you...
choice_data_list: I'd love to, let's definitely go!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Grass and river, cypress and sulfur. 
The fragrances here remain unchanged from 
times of old.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Onsen carrotsss! 
Who'd like some of our famous hot spring 
carrots—?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. 
One, if you please.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Here, Trainer. 
It seems to be a local specialty.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure? But what about yours, 
Azuma-san—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Pay me no mind. 
If it brings you pleasure, that is quite 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I split the hot spring carrot in half 
and handed one to Azuma-san.
choice_data_list:
I'd be much happier if we can enjoy it 
together.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
——... 
It is so warm... and truly delightful in 
sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome! 
We have been awaiting your arrival, 
Lady Azuma, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
We shall attend to you with all our heart, 
so please let both body and soul be 
thoroughly soothed♪

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Soaking in a footbath like this... 
the warmth truly seeps in through the 
soles of one's feet.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it slowly warms you up... feels 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the footbath, we soaked in the 
open-air bath 
recommended by the proprietress, warming 
ourselves right down to the core.

text_block_list.name: Kiyoko Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Now then, after a nice dip in the hot 
springs, 
be sure to get plenty of nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent kaiseki meal. 
Allow me to serve the hot pot.
choice_data_list: Wait, really?! You don't have to...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Please, think nothing of it. 
I am the one hosting you today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, all you need to do 
is simply... "ree-lax."
choice_data_list:
(...Well, Azuma looks like she's having 
fun, so why not?)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I am told the proper way to 
conclude 
a visit to an onsen town is at the 
souvenir shop.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, 
does anything catch your eye?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you can't go wrong with onsen 
manju. 
I was just thinking an Uma daruma doll 
might look nice 
in the trainer's office too, when—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, shopkeeper. 
We would like the items he just picked 
out, please.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, shopkeeper. 
We would like the items she just picked 
out, please.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Please, accept them. 
As a memento of our day together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After being thoroughly pampered and 
treated by Azuma 
like that, we left the onsen town behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire time, Azuma seemed quietly 
cheerful, 
perhaps even more expressive than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strange sense of lingering unease 
wouldn't leave me... 
Unable to shake it off, 
I went back to visit Azuma after we parted 
ways.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the grand hall, Azuma seemed to be 
speaking 
to the shrine maidens gathered before her.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Do you all understand, then? 
From here on, I entrust the outward duties 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I shall withdraw to the detached pavilion 
for a time 
to prepare for the appointed hour and 
focus on my duties.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Therefore— 
I shall also sever ties with the outside 
world for a while.
choice_data_list: Wait, Azuma... What do you mean by that—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
——... 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: It is precisely as I have said.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As of late... it seems I have spent 
far too much time in your presence.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Though my role is merely to watch over the 
path of humans and horsegirls, 
...I have drawn a little too close.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I must re-examine 
my true place and purpose once more.
choice_data_list: Your purpose? What do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
The closer one draws, 
the harder it becomes to see what lies 
beyond.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
<username>. 
Thank you for everything up until now.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The radiant, precious moments you gave 
me... 
I shall never forget them.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
May your journey ahead 
be blessed with fortune and happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My hands were gently wrapped 
in a cool, familiar touch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And before I knew it, 
I was standing all alone in the central 
plaza.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In my hands was a paper bag. 
Inside were onsen manju and an Uma daruma 
doll.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, out of nowhere— 
Azuma's face came to mind, back when she 
helped me 
look for documents at the Shuntaisai 
Executive Office.
choice_data_list:
I haven't seen her since then... I should 
thank her sometime.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
"Memories remain as recorded lore, 
and turning the page brings bygone days 
once more—"

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Even if you should forget... 
I, at least, shall always remember.
